svg.title: The best published energies, by system size
svg.desc: Number of sites (x) against relative gap to the reference ground-state energy (y, inverted log scale, better is higher) for 417 published energies on 229 instances with an exact or unbiased QMC energy.
svg.text: The best published energies, by system size
417 energies on the 229 instances with an exact or unbiased QMC ground-state energy, placed by their relative gap to it so that
different Hamiltonians share one axis; a better energy is higher. Colour is the kind of number; filled marks can hold a record,
relative gap to the instance's reference energy (better is higher)
Height is |E − E_ref| / |E_ref| on an inverted log scale, so that a better energy is higher; 34 rows closer than 10⁻⁸ sit on the top line. No line
joins the sizes: the instances at one size are different Hamiltonians, and a frontier across them would compare a Hubbard energy with a
Heisenberg one. The reference is exact diagonalization where it exists, otherwise sign-problem-free QMC, which is unbiased but not exact;
